title: The Covenant at Sinai
description: Moses tells the people all the Lord's words and laws, and the people promise to obey. He builds an altar with twelve stone pillars, offers burnt offerings and peace offerings, and sprinkles the blood of the covenant on the altar and the people. Together with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders, he sees the God of Israel. Then Moses goes up the mountain, where the Lord's glory rests like a consuming fire, and he stays there for forty days and forty nights to receive the stone tablets.
